lines.text: I used to rule the world
lines.ipa: ái iústu rúl dã uãrld

lines.text: Seas would rise when I gave the word
lines.ipa: sís uúd ráiz uén ái gêiv dã uãrd

lines.text: Now in the morning I sleep alone
lines.ipa: náu in dã mórnin ái slíp ãlôun

lines.text: Sweep the streets I used to own
lines.ipa: suíp dã stríts ái iústu ôun

lines.text: I used to roll the dice
lines.ipa: ái iústu rôul dã dáis

lines.text: Feel the fear in my enemies' eyes
lines.ipa: fíl dã fír in mái énãmiz áiz

lines.text: Listen as the crowd would sing
lines.ipa: lísãn éz dã cráud uúd síng

lines.text: Now the old king is dead, long live the king
lines.ipa: náu dã ôuld kíng iz déd, lòng lív dã kíng

lines.text: One minute I held the key
lines.ipa: uãn mínãt ái réld dã kí

lines.text: Next the walls were closed on me
lines.ipa: nékst dã uóls uãr clôuzd ón mi

lines.text: And I discovered that my castles stand
lines.ipa: énd ái discãvãrd dét mái kástãls sténd

lines.text: Upon pillars of salt and pillars of sand
lines.ipa: ãpón pílãrs óv sólt énd pílãrs óv sénd

lines.text: Refrão:
I hear Jerusalem bells a-ringing
lines.ipa: ái rír djãrúsãlém béls ã rínguin

lines.text: Roman cavalry choirs are singing
lines.ipa: rôumãn kévãlri kuáiãrs ár sínguin

lines.text: Be my mirror, my sword and shield
lines.ipa: bi mái mírãr, mái sôrd énd shíld

lines.text: My missionaries in a foreign field
lines.ipa: mái míshãnériz in ã fórãn fíld

lines.text: For some reason I can't explain
lines.ipa: fór sãm rízãn ái ként expléin

lines.text: Once you'd gone there was never
lines.ipa: uãns iu'd gón dér uóz névãr

lines.text: Never an honest word
lines.ipa: névãr ãn ónést uãrd

lines.text: And that was when I ruled the world
lines.ipa: énd dét uóz uén ái rúld dã uãrld

lines.text: It was a wicked and wild wind
lines.ipa: it uóz ã uíkéd énd uáild uínd

lines.text: Blew down the doors to let me in
lines.ipa: blú dáun dã dórs tu lét mi in

lines.text: Shattered windows and the sound of drums

lines.text: People couldn't believe what I'd become
lines.ipa: pípãl cúdãnt bilív uát áid bicãm

lines.text: Revolutionaries wait

lines.text: For my head on a silver plate

lines.text: Just a puppet on a lonely string
lines.ipa: djãst ã pãpét ón ã lôunli stríng

lines.text: Oh who would ever want to be king?
lines.ipa: ôu rú uúd évãr uãnt tu bi kíng?
